children: Greece’s trade deficit widened to EUR 3.1 billion in July 2026 from EUR 3.0 billion in the same month a year earlier, marking the largest deficit since December 2025.
Imports rose 10.7% year-on-year to EUR 8.2 billion, supported by increased shipments from third countries (+24.7%), while imports from EU countries declined (-0.4%).
Meanwhile, exports grew by 15.9% to EUR 5.1 billion, mainly driven by higher shipments to both EU countries (+10.9%) and third countries (+22.9%).
Over the January–July period, the trade deficit narrowed to EUR 19.1 billion from EUR 19.9 billion in the corresponding period of the previous year.

title: Greece Trade Gap Hits Eight-Month High
